text.base:
THE BARDO BARD
v?.?.? — uptime: [NaN]

NOTICE, FILED IN PLAIN LANGUAGE:
This experience concerns death, grief, guilt, memory,
and other existential themes. It will also, at times,
deliberately tempt you and apply emotional pressure to you.
That is part of the piece, and the piece will show its hand.

Your choices here are counted — anonymously, as bare tallies —
alongside every soul who has ever stood at this desk.
Nothing you type leaves this machine.
We count deeds, not people.
(You cannot type anyway. The keyboard budget was reallocated.)

nodes.a11y: A plain-language content and data notice from the Bardo Bard, followed by two options: begin, or not today.
nodes.fallback: A notice about death, counting, and consent. Begin, or don't.

text.base:
Understood.

Go well.
